about: E9 layer registry. Adding a layer is an entry here, not code. kind: h3-cells (file per horizon from the data build), geojson (static outline), points-binary (packed point records with an index.json describing the layout; built by crc_lab.storm_events).

basemap.attribution: Basemap © OpenFreeMap, © OpenMapTiles, data © OpenStreetMap contributors

layers.title: Texas boundary
layers.source: U.S. Census Bureau, TIGER/Line cartographic boundary cb_2024_us_state_500k

layers.title: Hottest day of the year, ERA5 baseline 1991–2020
layers.source: ERA5 reanalysis (1.5° WeatherBench2 copy), curves fitted by crc-sdk (GEV, L-moments)
layers.licence: CC BY 4.0; contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information
layers.caveat: Historical baseline, not a projection: annual maxima 1991–2020 from a 1.5° reanalysis, fitted per H3 resolution-4 cell (about 1,770 km²). Reanalysis underestimates local extremes; a cell is an area average. Horizon 2005 is the window centre.

layers.title: Tropical cyclone tracks, 1980–2024
layers.source: NOAA NCEI IBTrACS v04r01, North Atlantic basin, via crc-sdk IBTrACSPlan
layers.licence: U.S. government work; attribution requested (Schreck et al. 2024, doi:10.25921/82ty-9e16)
layers.caveat: Storms with at least one best-track point inside the Texas box; tracks clipped to a box around Texas. Track points are not asset winds or return-period curves.

layers.title: Coastal water levels, published return levels
layers.source: NOAA CO-OPS Extreme Water Levels, via crc-sdk NOAAExtremeWaterLevelPlan
layers.licence: U.S. government work; attribution requested (NOAA CO-OPS)
layers.caveat: Levels as published by NOAA (annual exceedance probabilities from a detrended series, relative to the station datum); not fitted by crc-sdk. A station is a point, not a stretch of coast.

layers.title: Hottest hour of the year at airport stations, 2000–2024
layers.source: NOAA GHCNh hourly temperature, curves fitted by crc-sdk (GEV, L-moments)
layers.licence: CC0-1.0 per the AWS registry; attribution requested (NOAA GHCNh)
layers.caveat: Historical observations at a point, not a projection; extremes of sampled hourly temperature, not daily TXx. Curves are crc-sdk's fit from 2000–2024 (at least 15 valid years).

layers.title: Storm Events (NOAA reports)
layers.source: NOAA NCEI Storm Events Database, cleaned by crc-lab
